headline: Claim Marcus Mariota tonight before the Wed 12:05 AM PT waiver run — Jayden Daniels' recurring elbow dislocation has no return timeline and Mariota is Washington's starter, filling your empty QB3 slot while Caleb Williams is out.
summary: At 1-1, your Sunday lineup is already right (Geno Smith at superflex, Chase Brown/Warren/Waddle/Nabers/Shakir/Jones/Johnson starting) and both injured players are already parked on IR. The one open item is a Tuesday-night waiver claim: Mariota just took over Washington's offense and you have an open bench spot to stash him as real QB3 depth since Caleb Williams' hamstring is week-to-week. Set both auto-subs for your two Questionable starters before Sunday.

adds.why: tier 2, bid 19 of your 144 — Washington named Mariota the starter Mon Sep 21 after Jayden Daniels dislocated the same elbow he hurt last season (cost him 3 weeks then) with no timeline yet; this restores your 3rd startable QB while Caleb Williams is out, and 2-QB rivals (wflemons33, EasyIP, MasonMafia, all with 130-150 FAAB left) may also bid.
adds.evidence: Room shows M. Mariota QB1, J. Daniels QB2 (Out, Elbow) as of the Sep 22 sweep; NFL.com/CBS Sports (Sep 21) confirm Daniels suffered a dislocated left elbow vs Dallas, X-rays showed no fracture but no return timeline was set, and this is a recurrence of a Nov 2025 injury that kept him out 3 weeks. No drop needed — Danny's roster has one open bench spot (17 of 18 rostered) after the Caleb Williams/A.J. Brown IR moves.

subs.why: Nabers is Questionable (shoulder popped out of place vs the Rams on Mon Sep 21, put back in himself, X-rays pending, Giants deciding on Week 3 status); both he and Johnston kick off Sun 10:00 AM, so set the pair before then.

Jones is Questionable (knee) but Vikings coach said Mon Sep 21 he's sore but expected to play Sunday; Judkins kicks off earlier (Sun 10:00 AM vs Jones' Sun 1:05 PM) and is full cover here even after his game ends, so set the pair before Sun 10:00 AM.
